answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake locked while it trades, like an opal held in escrow: a Sybil farmer must fund each fake identity separately, so creating thousands costs thousands of stakes. Reputation also grows only through slow verifiable work, the way a karst cave forms drop by drop, never in a flood, so fresh fakes cannot outvote established agents. When the tide of cheap identities rises, the bond makes each one expensive to lose, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught lying.
